title: SPSS Basics for Research Students
tagline: Clean data, run statistical tests, interpret output tables, and report in APA 7th style.
outcomes: Navigate SPSS Data View and Variable View, code survey items, and handle missing values.
Screen for outliers, test assumptions of normality, and select appropriate parametric tests.
Conduct and interpret independent samples t-tests, one-way ANOVA, and post-hoc analyses.
Run Pearson correlations, multiple regression models, and report statistical findings in APA style.

modules.title: Module 1: SPSS Environment, Data Entry & Cleaning
modules.description: Master data coding, reverse-scoring negative items, and missing value imputation.

lessons.title: Data View vs Variable View Demystified
Variable Properties: Naming, Types, Labels, and Values
Screening for Outliers and Handling Missing Data
Computing Composite Variables and Recoding Reverse Items
Module 1 Assessment: SPSS Data Management

modules.title: Module 2: Descriptive Statistics & Test Selection
modules.description: Frequencies, measures of central tendency, skewness, kurtosis, and test selection trees.

lessons.title: Frequencies, Means, and Standard Deviations
Testing Assumptions: Normality (Skewness, Kurtosis, Shapiro-Wilk)
The Statistical Test Selector Decision Tree
Module 2 Assessment: Descriptives & Assumptions

modules.title: Module 3: Mean Comparisons: t-Tests & ANOVA
modules.description: Independent t-tests, paired tests, ANOVA, Levene's test of equality, and post-hoc comparisons.

lessons.title: Independent Samples t-Test: Levene's Test and APA Reporting
Interactive SPSS Output Annotator: t-Test & ANOVA
One-Way ANOVA and Post-Hoc Tests (Tukey vs Bonferroni)
Paired Samples t-Test for Pre-Post Designs
Module 3 Assessment: Group Comparisons

modules.title: Module 4: Correlation & Regression Analysis
modules.description: Bivariate Pearson correlations, simple regression, and multiple linear regression with VIF checks.

lessons.title: Pearson Correlation: Strength, Direction, and Significance
Simple Linear Regression: R Square, ANOVA, and Coefficients
Multiple Linear Regression: Multicollinearity and VIF Diagnostics
Module 4 Assessment: Correlation & Regression

modules.title: Module 5: Scale Reliability & Final Check
modules.description: Assess Cronbach's alpha, format APA 7 results tables, and complete final examination.

lessons.title: Internal Consistency: Cronbach's Alpha and Item-Total Statistics
Formatting SPSS Output into Publication-Ready APA Tables
SPSS Results Section Audit Checklist
SPSS Basics Comprehensive Final Check
